summary: requirement_detail() re-hoists a full-corpus build_member_index unconditionally, undoing READ-VERBS-MEMBER-INDEX-HOIST's fix to the same function 40 minutes earlier the same session.

per.section: Cost scale is hoisted, and pinned by count

edit.description: requirement_detail (1468-1579) calls `let member_index = build_member_index(by_kind);` unconditionally at 1477 — before the `roster.get(name)` early return (1479-1496) and before checking whether `requirement.verifier` is `Telemetry` at all (1510). The index (an O(corpus) scan over every kind's every member, 136-149) is read only inside that one `if let Some(compose::Verifier::Telemetry { events })` branch (1515-1521, passed to `telemetry::requirement_field`). Move the `build_member_index` call inside that branch, immediately before its use — the undeclared-name early return and every non-Telemetry-verified requirement (the common case) currently pay the full-corpus build for nothing.

tests.asserts: an_unfilled_telemetry_requirement_with_an_empty_log_narrates_the_field_strand and an_unfilled_telemetry_requirement_narrates_records_against_the_declared_member_corpus (added by 03083596) stay green — narration is byte-identical once the build moves inside the branch

a new proof in impact_tests pins the count: build_member_index does not run for an undeclared requirement name and does not run for a declared, non-Telemetry-verified requirement — only a Telemetry-verified requirement triggers the build

acceptance: requirement_detail builds a member index only on the path that reads it (a Telemetry-verified requirement's field strand); an undeclared name or a non-Telemetry requirement narrates without paying the full-corpus scan; every existing read-family test (src/read.rs's impact_tests, tests/read_verbs.rs) passes unchanged.
notes: Verified on disk at HEAD (7d534e28): 9b2fb784 ('Hoist build_member_index calls...', 17:48:44) deleted this exact unconditional build from requirement_detail — neither branch read it; 03083596 (18:28:49, same session) re-added it unconditionally at 1477 to thread member_index into the new Telemetry-unfilled join, without re-narrowing to the branch that needs it. Purely mechanical (a call-site move), no design decision. scoped at 7d534e28.

summary: Keystroke JSON Schema wiring for JSON/TOML-document kinds (settings-local, plugin-manifest, marketplace, dial) has no modeline mechanism — deferred out of the YAML-frontmatter widening.

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

gate.reason: project_modeline (src/install.rs:1615) reads YAML frontmatter only (frontmatter::frontmatter_matter); a JSON document's native $schema key or a TOML equivalent needs its own design before schema/install extend to those kinds. Ruled (interactive, 2026-07-23) explicitly NOT build's to invent — surface only, never half-invent it. Revive when a JSON/TOML-kind keystroke gap has a real driver.

edit.description: Anticipated: `project_modeline`/`schema_ref` (~1594-1623) grow a JSON-document and/or TOML-document variant once a design exists — a JSON `$schema` top-level key insertion (JSON has no comment channel, so no `MODELINE_MARKER` prefix), a TOML equivalent is unprecedented and needs its own ruling.

acceptance: A JSON- or TOML-document kind (settings-local, plugin-manifest, marketplace, dial, or a declared kind sharing one of those formats) gets keystroke schema validation wired by `install`, once a modeline-equivalent mechanism is designed for its format.
notes: Surfaced by inbox #13 (observed at fc77716) alongside SCHEMA-KIND-DOMAIN-WIDEN; deliberately split so the YAML-frontmatter widening isn't blocked on this open design question. scoped at 162e1cce.
